EXCLUSIONS.TITLE: Exclusions
EXCLUSIONS.INTRO: Taking an asset out of a test changes what is measured. The company proposes it and the consultant decides. While pending nothing changes: the asset still counts.
EXCLUSIONS.EMPTY_FILTER: There are no exclusions with that status.
EXCLUSIONS.STILL_COUNTS: Awaiting a decision: the asset still counts until the consultant approves it.
EXCLUSIONS.AWAITING_CONSULTANT: Waiting for a consultant: the company has none assigned, so the asset still counts.
EXCLUSIONS.APPROVE_CONFIRM_BODY: The asset will leave what this test measures until the exclusion expires. The probe measurement is not erased.

PERIOD.TITLE: Evaluation period
PERIOD.SUBTITLE: {{name}}
PERIOD.INTRO: Tell Monkey which dates the evaluation covers. Without a period compliance cannot be measured and everything shows as “Not measured”.
PERIOD.SINGLE_DAY_HINT: If the evaluation is for a single date (SOC 2 Type I), use the same day for the start and the end.
PERIOD.FREEZE_HINT: If you do not freeze it, the cutoff date is always today (never outside the period). Freezing it fixes up to which day things were looked at; it does not delete evidence or results.
PERIOD.SAVED: Period saved. Compliance of this service can now be measured.
PERIOD.SAVE_ERROR: The period could not be saved. Please try again.
PERIOD.ERR_RANGE: The end cannot be before the start.
PERIOD.ERR_CUTOFF_OUT: The cutoff date must fall within the period.
PERIOD.ERR_CUTOFF_FUTURE: The cutoff date cannot be in the future.
PERIOD.ASK_ADMIN: Ask the company administrator to set it.
